P01.note: 'Without dissent' rules out divided and the union never meeting again until 1919 rules out defanged (weakened but still alive); doomed is the near-miss but describes a future end, while the fund repayment, hall sale and vote to comply ended it at once.

P02.note: The fleet crossing anywhere on the flood rules out chokepoint and barricade, and swells running across rules out breakwater; causeway rests on joining the dry-crest sentence with the sheep grazing the island, which the passage leaves implicit.

P03.note: 'Each staying a few days before going on' practically defines hostel; hatchery is the near-miss, ruled out because spawning happens on gravel beds miles above; garden falls on a surface read (off-register for a log in a salmon run).

P04.note: Each distractor is killed by one planted phrase: razed and pitted by 'look as they do in old photographs', poisoned by 'trout still rise'; riddled follows from the subsidence (road dropping, spring vanishing, floors splitting).

P05.note: 'As though seen through frost' hands over clouded; blackened is killed by 'whiter than before', blistered by 'smooth as glass', cracked by 'held tea without a mark'. Every option gets one direct contradiction, so no near-miss is left.

P06.note: The keeper driving to the hooked tip kills cleaved and blunted, the loose sand being gone kills broadened; armored rests on the exposed cobble bed plus less ground lost over the next twenty winters.

P07.note: The back chamber 'stays near freezing' literally fits icebox and the ford view literally fits lookout, but winter hearths after the herds left, bedding, hide scrapers and children's shed milk teeth together point to a dwelling; mortuary is killed because milk teeth are shed, not left by the dead.

P08.note: The quays under the harbor literally fit submerged, but the eastern caves rising nine meters show one end went up while the other went down; the farms unchanged in between kill smothered and scoured. The reader has to combine east and west.

P09.note: Stubble gone, crust turned up in slabs, soil heaped into ridges with furrows, and seed sown into the furrows together describe plowing; reseeded is killed because the farmers sowed, replenished because only pale sandy soil was left; rinsed (the salt crust) is the near-miss, but the crust was broken and turned, not washed away.

P10.note: The shops going from daily prices to once-a-season price lists decides steadied; stifled is the near-miss (crews lost their freedom to sell) but buyers came every day; uprooted and saturated have no support.

P11.note: 'Each undoing the one before' plus a final rate within a cent of the first decides pendulum; ratchet (one-way) is the reverse; regulator is weakened by rises coming in record-price years.

P12.note: 'Drop the slides and cracks from their voices' with retuning to standard pitch decides smoothed; stripped is the near-miss but is killed by 'still sang every verse', and silenced by singing all over the region.

P13.note: Yearly layers giving the only rainfall record points to ledger, but 'the shrimp and plankton in its water are those of every lake nearby' plus 'studied more closely than any other lake' arguably supports microcosm (a typical lake studied as a sample of the region). If that sentence is meant to kill microcosm it does the opposite; the author should rewrite it.

P14.note: Radio reached listeners a day ahead (papers lost first place for news) while circulation kept rising, which kills hamstrung; homogenized partly fits the shared wire service, but that predates radio; dethroned depends on combining both sentences.

P15.note: Fort over the only water, a tenth taken from every load, enemies turned back: a controlled point of passage. 'The rest of each load went on to the coast unopened' kills emporium and fairground; estate is weak.

P16.note: Springs holding up and canoes floating over riffles kill pinched and parched, 'ran fast and clear' kills pooled; trout dying in shallow treeless water but surviving in shade near cold springs points to heat.

P17.note: The same population, the same families running the stores and a newest building from 1951 decide fossilized; drained is killed by the steady population, engulfed and fragmented by the road running on the far bank with its exit nine miles off.

P18.note: Ice covering the bay literally fits roof, but the algae film feeding krill, then cod, then seals makes it a food store; raft is killed by krill staying behind when the ice drifts off, and perch is weak because seals hunt from holes rather than resting on the ice.

P19.note: Strong solvents working into the paint and glazes coming off on the swabs point to overcleaning; uncovered is the near-miss (the varnish was removed) but ignores the damage; 'went back into the frame as they had come out' kills transferred and stabilized.

P20.note: Kept all eleven episodes and the same telling length kills distilled, kept the desert capital kills domesticated; rising tricks, a rhyme and the surprise moved to the end make honed, while fused is weak.

P21.note: Barges tying up in deep still water decides anchorage; each distractor has one direct kill: floods cover the island (ark), the channel is too deep to wade (crossing), raiders moored there (citadel).

P22.note: Even the accidental chipped claw is copied at a third the size, which decides replica; offshoot is the near-miss (the families still go to the city festival); precursor is killed because a copy of a 1580 accident must come later, and rival by that dependence.

P23.note: Every engineer and foreman spending two years on its line before running the inland factories decides schoolhouse; toehold is killed because the company already owned two factories, and a few hundred cars a year in a plain shed weakens showroom and warehouse.

P24.note: After three dry years the wheat came up thick on flooded farms but withered on the terraces, so the gain was water; 'ran clear' kills nourished (no silt), boundaries left as they were kills leveled, and marooned has no support.

P25.note: Seepage through the limestone, half the inflow out and none in dry summers decide sink; tributary is the reverse; thermostat fails because the shallow lake warms the outflow rather than regulating it; valve is a plausible near-miss but implies control.

P26.note: The warehouses literally fit depot, but ships came in only when gales blew and passed by in calm weather, which makes the island a refuge; gateway is weakened by ships passing on either side.

P27.note: Sacks handed out until nearly every field was sown from them, and the crosses spreading into three counties, decide wellspring; testbed literally fits the crossing work, and stopgap fits filling the gap left by the closed merchant but nothing marks it as temporary.

P28.note: Air blowing out before a storm and back in after, through the only opening, decides bellows; 'no other opening' kills chimney, the brook running out kills cistern, and the same mild air winter and summer weakens cooler.

P29.note: Barge traffic, guild warehouses on both banks and tolls as the largest revenue item give artery away through the ordinary city-artery idiom; border has some literal support (runs beside the old center), but commons and aqueduct are weak and nothing is a real near-miss.

P30.note: Twelve owners' marks and a crew of twelve sharing the shed decide kitty (a pooled fund); loot is the near-miss (coins from a dozen ports), and inventory and insurance are weak.

P31.note: 'Laid no eggs at all' decides neutered; ducks taking both kinds at the same rate kills manipulated, the bacterium killing both alike kills immunized, and milked is weak.

P32.note: Icy bodies thrown onto stretched paths and out of the system decide slingshot; umbrella (the familiar Jupiter-as-shield idea) is killed by impacts about as frequent as without the giant; shepherd and tether imply holding bodies in place, but the belt lost half its members.

P33.note: Nightly winter hunting, burrows emptied by late winter, and stoats staying away in summer when the woods have voles decide larder; lair is killed by stoats going back to their woods before dawn, and lane by each returning to the wood it came from; inn is the weak member.

P34.note: A naval shipyard payment from an oak-wood estate, then extra men hired to pull stumps and sow grass, means timber was sold; the regular hands' wages running on to 1858 kill liquidated and leased, and nothing marks the payment as a loan (mortgaged). The reader has to infer the timber.

P35.note: Members of all three parties came and news passed from table to table, which decides hub; offices elsewhere kill headquarters, reporters going to those offices kill embassy, and hothouse is a plausible near-miss.

P36.note: 'The town's grocers buy most of their week's stock on its floor' with weekly farmers' carts gives bazaar away; cesspool falls on a surface read (a pejorative with nothing behind it in a dry, level pit); short galleries used as stables kill bunker; arena has only the pit shape.

P37.note: An electric machine the rival had dismissed, sharing not one part, then outselling it, decides leapfrogged; mimicked is killed by sharing no parts, and selling through the same dealers weakens isolated and infiltrated.

P38.note: Removal by weight and the paper ministry listing two hundred tons for its printing decide pulped; plundered is the near-miss but loses to the precise reuse; the rare-book room left untouched kills purged's ideological sense and padlocked.

P39.note: Trade moving from the river landing to the back street with the population steady at about eight hundred decides reoriented; the steady population kills repopulated and ruined, and nothing supports overran.

P40.note: Selling grain to the best-paying port even in famine years, and needing no hearth tax except when war closed the river, makes the granary a revenue source; backstop is killed by shipping grain out in famines; cudgel is a near-miss planted by the lords quarrelling over tolls; ballast is weak.
